name: taskforce
description: Supervise terminal-visible coding CLIs through cmux — launch them, read their real TUIs, and keep watching until the work is truly done.

interface.longDescription: Taskforce launches coding CLIs in visible cmux surfaces, reads their real terminals every 10-20 seconds, and lets Chief decide per node: continue, answer a permission menu, correct goal or boundary drift, or recover an exited worker. It verifies goal and implementation before marking a node done. It is not a role system, model router, patch integration framework, or general workflow platform.
defaultPrompt: Use Taskforce. Launch opencode to implement the feature and run its tests. Keep supervising until done.
Use Taskforce. Launch codex to design, then claude to implement, then opencode to review. Supervise the whole workflow.
Use Taskforce. Launch parallel workers for the backend and frontend, then a reviewer. Supervise until complete.
